question: Which constitutional amendment of the Constitution of India is related to the establishment of National Commission for Backward Classes in India?

options.text: Constitution (One Hundred and Second Amendment) Act, 2018
Constitution (One hundred and fourth Amendment) Act, 2019

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Constitution (One Hundred and Second Amendment) Act, 2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Constitution (One Hundred and Second Amendment) Act, 2018** is related to the **establishment of the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC).**
 
• This amendment introduced significant changes in the Indian Constitution by adding **Article 338B** and **Article 342A.**
